title: Chough change ship: ship after the review, close the review gate with the relay, and move to done (179, DRIVE-20)
description: chough change ship: ship after the review, close the review gate with the relay, and move to done (179, DRIVE-20)
acceptance_criteria: REQ-cli-059 (new): chough change ship <id> with the review gate's relay checks the session, stage, open gates and relay before anything runs (each refusal names a recovery that a test runs), runs specsync change ship <id> unbounded with its output and refusals passed through, then closes the gate as a relayed claim and moves the session to done; a refused step after a successful ship exits 1, says shipped and names the remaining command, which a test runs. The walkthrough and the skill's closeout run chough change new, check and ship, with review still specsync change review. Six tests in tests/change.rs fail first, each mutant in testing.md fails one of them, and fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux.

answers.constraints: Issue #179, slice 2 of Chough drives SpecSync; slice order approved by Leif (relayed by the orc, 2026-11-06), with option A from #174's re-approval moving the walkthrough's direct calls here. DRIVE-20; DRIVE-2 (the done move keeps one native read); DRIVE-4 (nothing writes .chough/ between check and finalize, so the gate closes after ship); FLOW-14; FLOW-16 as amended and FLOW-10 (only the given relayed decision is recorded). REQ-cli-050 and REQ-cli-052 unchanged; REQ-cli-059 is this change's, REQ-cli-058 is #177's. Rule: a refusal names a recovery command and a test runs it. Lesson: merge main before review and rebuild the vault.
